title: Chapter 6: Life in the Castle and the Beast’s Kindness
chineseTitle: 第 6 章：城堡生活与野兽的体贴

paragraphs.en: 'Have you come here of your own free will?' asked the Beast in a low, rumbling voice. 'Yes,' whispered Beauty, her voice trembling slightly. 'You are noble and good,' said the Beast softly. 'Old man, tomorrow morning you shall depart for home, and you must never set foot in this palace again.' Turning to Beauty, he added gently, 'Good night, Beauty.' 'Good night, Beast,' she replied quietly.
paragraphs.zh: “你是出自你自己的自由意志来到这里的吗？”野兽用低沉轰鸣的声音问。“是的，”贝儿低语道，声音稍微发颤。“你高尚而善良，”野兽软软地说。“老人家，明天早上你必须启程回家，再也不许踏入这座城堡一步。”转向贝儿，他温柔地补充道：“晚安，贝儿。”“晚安，野兽，”她平静地回答。

paragraphs.en: Beauty expected to be devoured during the night, but when she woke the next morning, she was astonished to find herself in a luxurious chamber fit for a queen. Attached to her bedroom was a vast library containing thousands of illuminated books, a music room with rare harps, and magical mirrors that allowed her to view any part of the world at will. Above her door, golden letters read: 'Welcome, Princess; your every wish is our command.'
paragraphs.zh: 贝儿预料夜晚会被吞噬，但当她第二天早上醒来时，她惊讶地发现自己身处于一个适合王后居住的奢华房间里。紧挨着她卧室的是一座巨大的图书馆，藏有成千上万本精美的图书，一个配备有罕见竖琴的音乐室，以及允许她随意观看世界任何角落的魔法镜子。在她门上方，黄金字写着：“欢迎，公主；您的一切愿望都是我们的指令。”

paragraphs.en: Every evening at nine o'clock, the Beast joined Beauty for dinner. Instead of a savage monster, Beauty discovered that the Beast spoke with profound wisdom, rich humor, and boundless gentle courtesy. Though his terrifying appearance initially frightened her, she grew accustomed to his ugliness and looked forward to their evening chats. Yet before leaving each night, the Beast would look into her eyes and ask timidly, 'Beauty, will you marry me?' And each night, Beauty would softly reply, 'No, Beast, but I am your sincere friend.'
paragraphs.zh: 每天晚上九点钟，野兽都会与贝儿共进晚餐。贝儿没有发现野羊般野蛮的怪物，而是发现野兽的谈吐充满了深刻的智慧、丰富的幽默与无尽的温柔礼貌。尽管他可怕的外表最初吓到了她，但她逐渐习惯了他的丑陋，并期待着他们的晚间交谈。然而在每天晚上离开前，野兽都会看着她的眼睛怯生生地问：“贝儿，你愿意嫁给我吗？”而每天晚上，贝儿都会软软地回答：“不，野兽，但我也是你真诚的朋友。”
